applicability_conditions: Varying deformation conditions; the assumption is based on the observation that θ₀ is mainly influenced by the deformation temperature.
purpose: States the assumption that the initial work-hardening rate under varying deformation conditions is taken to be equal to the corresponding initial hardening rate under constant conditions.

symbols.meaning: initial hardening rate under varying deformation conditions
initial hardening rate under constant deformation conditions, defined in Eq. (20) as θ₀ = ζ_ν(σ_s² − σ₀²)/(2σ₀)

unmapped: θ₀ in Eq. (20) involves ζ_ν, a coefficient corresponding to DRV that is only affected by deformation parameters.
